en: Deuteronomy 10

p.src: 1  At that time the LORD said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

ja: ってわたしのところに
en: At that time the LORD said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
u.src: 1  At that time the LORD said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

p.src: 2  I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

ja: き記す。あなたはそれを
en: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”
u.src: 2  I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

p.src: 3  So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

ja: そこでわたしはアカシアの
en: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.
u.src: 3  So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

p.src: 4  He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.

ja: は最初の書き記しと同じように、
から主があなたがたに
き記された。そして主はそれをわたしに与えられた。
en: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.
u.src: 4  He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and the LORD gave them to me.

p.src: 5  I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the LORD commanded me.

ja: わたしは向きを変えて
じられたように、それはそこにある。
en: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the LORD commanded me.
u.src: 5  I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the LORD commanded me.

p.src: 6  (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

ja: （イスラエルの子らはベエロト・ベネ・ヤアカンからモセラへ
en: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.
u.src: 6  (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

p.src: 7  From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

ja: そこから彼らはグドゴダへ
路の地であるヨトバタへ旅立った。
en: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.
u.src: 7  From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

p.src: 8  At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

ja: するために、レビの部族をえり分けられた。それは
en: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.
u.src: 8  At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to stand before the LORD to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

p.src: 9  Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD your God spoke to him.)

ja: それゆえ、レビには彼の
en: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD your God spoke to him.)
u.src: 9  Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD your God spoke to him.)

p.src: 10  I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.

ja: にとどまった。主はその
れられた。主はあなたを
ぼすことはされなかった。
en: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.
u.src: 10  I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me that time also. The LORD would not destroy you.

p.src: 11  The LORD said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

en: The LORD said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”
u.src: 11  The LORD said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

p.src: 12  Now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

ja: 今、イスラエルよ。あなたの
en: Now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
u.src: 12  Now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

p.src: 13  to keep the LORD’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

ja: あなたの幸せのために、わたしが
en: to keep the LORD’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
u.src: 13  to keep the LORD’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

p.src: 14  Behold, to the LORD your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

ja: とそこにあるすべてのものは、あなたの
en: Behold, to the LORD your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.
u.src: 14  Behold, to the LORD your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

p.src: 15  Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

ja: んで愛された。そして今日あるように、すべての民に勝って
en: Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.
u.src: 15  Only the LORD had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

p.src: 16  Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

ja: に割礼を施せ。もう、うなじを
en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.
u.src: 16  Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

p.src: 17  For the LORD your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

ja: らない、大いなる、力強い、恐るべき神だからである。
en: For the LORD your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.
u.src: 17  For the LORD your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

p.src: 18  He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

ja: は孤児ややもめのために
en: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.
u.src: 18  He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

p.src: 19  Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

ja: しなさい。あなたがたもエジプトの
en: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
u.src: 19  Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

p.src: 20  You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

en: You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.
u.src: 20  You shall fear the LORD your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

p.src: 21  He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

ja: るべきことをあなたのために
われた、あなたの神である。
en: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.
u.src: 21  He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

p.src: 22  Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.

en: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.
u.src: 22  Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the LORD your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.
